title: Miracles Happen When We Sow into God's Kingdom
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner teaches on the importance of giving and releasing God's blessing into the world, revealing the secrets to spiritual maturity and unlocking the promise of God's abundance in your life. Join us as we explore the biblical principles of sowing and reaping, and discover how your offerings can stop the bleeding in the lives of others and bring you into a place of peace and prosperity.
